type: Four original compact illustrations for Koko social app
layout: Precise 2x2 grid, four equal square cells. Center each complete subject within 74 percent of its cell, wide transparent gaps. Square overall atlas. No background tiles or dividers.
panels: TOP LEFT: mint and warm ivory over-ear headphones, small looping sage ribbon, one pale yellow star, no pedestal.
TOP RIGHT: a deep sage crescent moon embracing a small ivory vintage radio with mint accents, one small star, a quiet night conversation.
BOTTOM LEFT: two friendly interlocking mint and ivory speech bubbles, one small gold glint.
BOTTOM RIGHT: two overlapping small ivory photographic keepsake frames with simple mint landscape illustrations inside, sage ribbon corner, no writing.
style: Contemporary matte cut-paper illustration with restrained layered depth, clean bold silhouettes, subtle paper grain. Adult social editorial style. Mint #B9EDCE, forest #132A26, warm ivory, tiny muted gold accents. Consistent hand-crafted illustration, no glass or glossy plastic, no heavy shadows.
constraints: Genuine transparent alpha surrounding all four illustrations, interiors opaque. No rooms or photographic backgrounds, no furniture or architectural arch, no letters/logos/text. Do not crop subjects. All four distinct artworks must have clean separation and matching scale.

final_refinement.prompt: Preserve all original symbols, identities, colors and equal grid positions. Remove contaminated alpha fringes and speckles. Navigation: redraw as pure white strokes on pure black, for native luminance-mask display. Illustrations and collection: opaque uniform #132A26 matte, no background texture or shadows, clean subject edges.
